Travel Notice for Companion Animals

Travelers using the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways must confirm that carrier labels, animal documents, and handover details are ready before arrival. Please keep every item accessible and follow the direction of the desk staff without delay.

Our ground team will move carriers with care between check-in, service points, and the aircraft hold area, while the cabin team continues to monitor animals during flight. A welcome team will also prepare passengers for boarding and will guide movement through the departure area in an orderly way. If an animal needs special handling, advise the desk immediately so the route can be adjusted before transfer begins.

Keep the carrier secure, clean, and well ventilated, and avoid opening it unless a staff member instructs you to do so. Travelers should remain near the assigned area until the handover is complete, and they should listen for any further direction from the operations team. Clear communication helps protect the animal, reduces delay, and supports a smooth departure for everyone involved.

For assistance, please speak at once with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
